Noodle Dishes.name: Classic Pad Thai Noodles
Noodle Dishes.description: Thailand's most famous street food export - rice noodles flash-fried with egg, red onion, bean sprouts, spring onion and carrot in a sweet, tangy tamarind sauce. Learn about our Pad Thai noodles ⭐ Popular Chicken and prawn Pad Thai shown.

Noodle Dishes.name: Pad Kee Mao (Spicy Thai Drunken Noodles)
Noodle Dishes.description: For the spice lovers - wide rice noodles fiercely stir-fried with green bean, onion, mixed pepper, bamboo shoot, fresh chilli and Thai basil. 🌶🌶🌶 Very Hot Seafood Pad Kee Mao shown.

Noodle Dishes.name: Pad See Eew (Stir-Fried Thai Soya Noodles)

Noodle Dishes.name: Thai Flavoured Instant Noodles (Mama Stir-Fry)

Authentic Thai Salads & Side Dishes.name: Yum Talay (Spicy Thai Seafood Salad)
